slug: 2025-06-25 Trident and DR Congo sign final DRCPass PPP; nationwide deployment begins

facts.fact: The press release says Trident signed the definitive PPP on 25 June 2025 as exclusive e-KYC provider for 80 million+ mobile subscribers, with DRCPass use cases including biometric SIM registration and identity verification for digital payments and credit assessment.

systems.system: e-KYC for digital payments and credit assessment
